evidence: Written mathematical arguments, exact computational certificates, and separate internal AI reviews. Not externally peer reviewed or formally certified.
novelty: Bounded dated primary-source and later-literature checks; novelty is not certified.
catalog_policy: Two proposed affirmative resolutions and two counterexamples receive repository-local proved/disproved statuses. Three restricted results receive partial status; their unrestricted questions remain unresolved.

results.title: Monotonicity of percolation with constant freezing
results.result: Stochastic decrease in the freezing rate holds for every finite simple graph whose connected components each have at most five edges, for all positive rates. Exact polynomial certificates cover all 91,881 increasing events on the 22 connected graph classes.
results.boundary: The unrestricted finite-graph question remains unresolved. Larger connected graphs, multigraphs and infinite-volume processes are outside this result.
results.internal_review: Separate internal AI review; see the linked review. Not external peer review or formal certification.

results.title: Positive association for percolation with constant freezing
results.result: Positive association holds for every finite simple graph whose connected components each have at most four edges, for every positive freezing rate. All 71,637 unordered increasing-event-pair covariances have exact nonnegative polynomial certificates.
results.boundary: The unrestricted finite-graph question remains unresolved. The stronger FKG lattice condition is not asserted; a four-vertex path fails that condition by exactly -1/525 at rate one.
results.primary_location: Section 3.1.4 and Example 3.1.5, printed pp. 43–44 (PDF pp. 53–54).
results.internal_review: Separate internal AI review; see the linked review. Not external peer review or formal certification.

results.title: Sublinear regret when response memory spans the horizon
results.result: An explicit policy attains worst-case expected regret O_{K,c}(T^(4/5)(log T)^(1/5)) for known lambda=c/T and fixed K,c>0, uniformly over all reward/end-state parameters in [0,1]^(2K). Transient reference-arm probes and a polynomial-time grid planner compare with the full informed length-T sequence optimum.
results.boundary: No state observations, replenishing arm, positive reward lower bound or benchmark discount are assumed. The exponent is not claimed optimal; unknown lambda and growing K remain outside the theorem.
results.internal_review: Separate internal AI review; see the linked review. Not external peer review or formal certification.

results.title: A nonfree nilpotent Lie algebra with property F
results.result: An explicit 13-dimensional two-generated nilpotent Lie algebra of class five has property F for every generating pair over every characteristic-zero field, but is not free nilpotent. Its graded dimensions are 2,1,2,3,5 and its center has dimension five.
results.boundary: Disproves the proposed equivalence. The universal generating-pair assertion follows from a symmetric-matrix change-of-generators argument and graded injectivity, not from a finite search. No smallest-dimension or full classification claim is made.
results.internal_review: Separate internal AI review; see the linked review. Not external peer review or formal certification.

results.title: Partial inner automorphisms of matrix monoids
results.result: For every field F and finite-dimensional V, Inn(End_F(V)) consists exactly of restrictions of invertible conjugations to the full domain, the zero-matrix singleton, and D(U,W)={a:im(a) is contained in U, W is contained in ker(a)} with U,W both proper nonzero subspaces. Explicit equality, multiplication and inversion formulas give an isomorphism description.
results.boundary: The zero is the identity on the singleton {0}, not an empty partial map. All dimensions, nonsemisimple products and arbitrary fields are covered; the separate residual-finiteness question Q2304 is not addressed.
results.internal_review: Separate internal AI review; see the linked review. Not external peer review or formal certification.

results.title: Two-pass hare sorting over fixed alphabets
results.result: A finite automaton gives exact counts for each fixed alphabet and a matrix/inclusion-exclusion formula for every length. For Cayley words using exactly four symbols, the generating function is z^4(22-119z+162z^2)/((1-z)(1-2z)(1-3z)^4), with asymptotic n^3*3^n/324.
results.boundary: The explicit rational closed formula concerns the four-symbol slice. A closed generating function and useful uniform asymptotics for the unrestricted sum over alphabet sizes remain unresolved; the exponential-size general automaton is not presented as a complete resolution.
results.internal_review: Separate internal AI review; see the linked review. Not external peer review or formal certification.

results.title: A polygon-face Ehrhart counterexample
results.result: The full face lattice of a convex 13-gon, including the empty and full faces, has Ehrhart linear coefficient -298495711/35302608. This is the only negative coefficient of its degree-28 Ehrhart polynomial; every coefficient is positive for polygon sizes 3 through 12.
results.boundary: This disproves the Ehrhart coefficient question, distinct from the source's earlier negative order-polynomial coefficient for a 7-gon. Two separate exact arithmetic derivations verify the counterexample; no claim about other poset families is made.
